protocol: Actual 120Hz RaceSession, 13 cars, slipstream enabled on both sides, normal difficulty, two laps. Binary keyboard-equivalent player surrogate at 30Hz; no human performance or FPS claim. Observations at 30Hz, contacts/shoulders/walls are vehicle frames, not unique incidents. Assistance rank is the pre-step rank that determined the actual force, not a retroactively changed rank. Finished drivers receive no assistance; outlap contact/peak observations remain included.
